In Cobble ValleyWhat is this?
  • Your first night is different: no wool or shears needed. Make a leaf bed (3 leaves over 3 sticks), torches from leaves on a stick, and a campfire from sticks and logs (Bushcraft).
  • Wooden tools are free to craft. Anyone holding a crafting table and a wooden pickaxe completes First Steps, and the whole group enters the Stone Age.
  • The furnace, anvil and enchanting table must be learned before you can craft them: quest, teacher, or practice.
